newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU fin mins to meet informally before summit.
newsitem.headline: EU fin mins to meet informally before summit.

text.p: European Union Finance Ministers will probably meet informally on Sunday before the two-day EU summit meeting in Amsterdam on Monday and Tuesday, a Dutch government source told Reuters on Thursday.
The source, who asked not to be identified, said the ministers were likely to meet informally over dinner rather than hold a formal ECOFIN meeting.

"I don't think there will be an ECOFIN. There will be a gathering of the ministers on Sunday, I'm sure, but I don't think it will get the label of ECOFIN. It could be that it takes the form of a dinner or something like that," the source said.

Diplomats in some EU capitals had mooted a meeting of finance ministers to iron out residual problems so that EU leaders can sign a stability pact on maintaining budget discipline after the planned launch of a single currency.
